prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
ai_overview_text:
While "best" depends on your specific needs (such as single-tooth implants, full-mouth restorations, or All-on-4), several top-rated and specialized implant centers and dentists in Phoenix consistently receive the highest patient ratings and specialized credentials:
Specialty: Full-mouth reconstruction, All-on-4® treatments, and a digital in-house laboratory.
Key Credentials: Dr. Mehranfar has treated over 3,000 full-mouth implant cases and lectures internationally for Nobel Biocare and SprintRay.
Rating: 4.9/5 (571+ reviews)
Scope of Work: If you need a single tooth replaced, a general or restorative dentist with implant experience (like Central Valley Dentistry or Life Smiles Dental Care) is ideal. For full-arch or All-on-4 procedures, a dedicated center with an in-house lab (like Aria or Nuvia) streamlines the process. Life Smiles Dental Care +3
Consultations & 3D Imaging: Look for practices that offer a complimentary 3D CT scan and consultation to evaluate your jawbone density and map out the surgical guide beforehand. AZ Dentist +1
Credentials: Check whether the surgeon is a board-certified periodontist, oral surgeon, or prosthodontist, and ask about their specific volume of completed implant surgeries. AZ Dentist +1
Are you looking to replace a single tooth, multiple teeth, or do you need a full-mouth (All-on-4/X) solution? Let me know your preferred part of Phoenix or insurance/budget needs to narrow down the best fit.
